text:
leah: quick thought  propose a "syndicated conversion slab" for marketplace private offers: convert X% up front, additional slabs unlocked on renewal milestones + SI onboarding milestones. good idea?
tom: sounds strategic. helps co-sell partners and reduces friction to reserved commitments. which marketplaces and hardware partners?
leah: start with AWS + Azure private offers, pilot with one GPU hardware partner (NIMBUS) and one SI. keep GCP and others later.
priya: finance: need a slab table and clear expiry rules. suggest slab A=80% upfront, slab B=10% on first renewal (90d), slab C=10% on 12mo commit. will model rev-rec.
marco: ops: flow should be token verify -> mint Redwood reserved voucher -> set unlock triggers -> webhook to SI. ensure idempotent and audit logs.
legal: legal: watch marketplace terms on reissuing value; will draft clause for no-double-dip, expiry, and clawback. also confirm we can surface the option in partner portal.
acct-bot: acct-bot: created task ACCT-3344 to track revenue recognition impacts.
priya: also propose a small hardware co-invest (one-time $10k deployment credit) if SI uses partner hardware for first 3 months. helps partner ROI.
tom: GTM ask: need seller one-pager + partner FAQ. keep messaging: low friction, aligns incentives for renewal, faster time-to-value.
marco: tech note: SKU mapping table required between marketplace SKU and Redwood reserved SKU + mapping for hardware SKUs. I'll make INF-5001.
leah: pilot plan: 8-week pilot, 10 accounts, one SI, one hardware partner. deliverables: legal redline, finance model, ops prototype, seller doc. any objections?
priya: finance needs churn sensitivity by Wed.
legal: will circulate redline by Tue EOD.
tom: SE will draft seller doc and partner FAQ.
leah: thanks team  will brief GTM Friday if deliverables align.
note: Slack-thread style coordination about marketplace private-offer conversion slabs for committed reserved credits. Messages are short, chronological, and prefixed by sender names.
